horizon.prompt: When do you expect to need most of this money?

reaction.prompt: If your portfolio fell 20% in a month, you would…

objective.prompt: Your priority for this money is…

goals.title: Define the life goals
goals.subtitle: What the money is for — target amount, horizon and priority.
goals.empty: No goals yet. Add one to start.

goalDescription.retirement: Capital to keep the standard of living after stopping work, accounting for longevity.
goalDescription.education: Reserve for the dependents' education (school, college, exchange).
goalDescription.property: Buying or upgrading a home (down payment, payoff or cash purchase).
goalDescription.travel: A trip or experience planned for a specific date.
goalDescription.emergency_reserve: Liquidity buffer for the unexpected — a multiple of essential expenses.
goalDescription.legacy: Liquidity for succession (probate and transfer costs).
goalDescription.protection: Insurance cover to protect the family against risks.
goalDescription.custom: A custom goal defined by the advisor.

scenarios.title: Simulate the plan
scenarios.subtitle: Adjust the assumptions and watch the plan respond. Pre-asset-allocation.
scenarios.createFirst: Create the first scenario to simulate the plan.

review.title: Review & approve
review.subtitle: The plan summary before asset allocation. Approve to complete the journey.
review.approvedAt: This plan is approved — the hand-off point before asset allocation.
review.noScenario: Select a scenario in the previous step to review it.
review.downloadHint: This is a functional prototype — approval marks the plan complete in-app.

copilot.title: BIA advisor
copilot.subtitle: The advisor of the advisor
copilot.placeholder: Ask about markets, a concept, or draft a client event…

suggestions.s1: Explain IPCA+ vs. prefixado in simple terms

timeline.title: Timeline

intake.title: Client dossiers, received
intake.subtitle: Cadastral and financial data arrives from the bank's systems. Open a dossier to run the simulation.

workspace.createFirst: Create the first scenario to start the simulation loop.
workspace.compareSubtitle: Parameters and outcomes side by side.
workspace.compareEmpty: Create at least two scenarios to compare.

wealth.title: Wealth at retirement
wealth.body: What you'll have accumulated at retirement — today's investable wealth plus contributions and real growth.

duration.title: How long income lasts
duration.body: How many years the portfolio sustains the retirement income need before depleting.

probability.title: Probability of success
probability.body: Chance the plan funds the desired income across the whole horizon — capital at retirement vs. capital needed.

estate.title: Estate at horizon
estate.body: How much should remain at the end of the planning horizon (legacy / margin).

gap.title: Monthly income gap
gap.body: Difference between sustainable monthly income and the retirement need. Negative = shortfall; positive = surplus.

goals.title: Goals
goals.body: How many goals are achievable in the current scenario. Tap each one for detail.

library.title: Team personas
library.saved: Persona saved to the team library

dataDrawer.title: Client data
dataDrawer.subtitle: Fill or refine the dossier — the simulation updates live.

output.approvedHint: The payload is ready to hand off to Salesforce.
output.approveHint: Approve the selected scenario to enable the handoff.
output.approveToSend: Approve the plan to enable sending.

why.highCostDebt: High-cost debt is draining the budget — restructuring is the highest-return move.
why.soleProvider: Sole provider with dependents — protection is the priority.
why.dependents: Dependents to protect if income stops.
why.reserveGap: Liquid reserve is below three months of expenses.
why.idleCash: A large cash balance is sitting idle, losing to inflation.
why.noPensionPj: Self-employed with no private pension — the State won't cover it.
why.pensionTopUp: High income with room for tax-efficient pension contributions.
why.educationGoal: An education goal fits a programmed Educa+ plan.
why.propertyGoal: A property goal — model consórcio vs. financing.
why.mortgage: An active mortgage — model amortize-vs-invest and credit-life.
why.offshore: Wealth is BR-concentrated — add international diversification.
why.succession: A sizeable estate needs succession and liquidity planning.
why.autoInvest: Monthly surplus not yet automated into investments.
why.medicalContinuity: High recurring medical costs with dependents — fund the stream and secure coverage continuity.
why.incomeLadder: Approaching retirement — convert the portfolio into an inflation-protected income stream.
